name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: UX Research & Conversion Strategy
summary: User researcher and conversion strategist with 15+ years studying how real people actually use digital products. At Wix I ran moderated, task-based sessions with every e-commerce client launching a store, helped define the usability study approach as that vertical was built out, and turned what I observed into personas, layout changes, and site-structure recommendations that lifted conversion 25% and traffic 30%. I work hypothesis-first: state what I think the behavior data is showing, test it, and change the recommendation when the evidence says otherwise. I also build LLM workflows and evaluation loops directly, so I understand what usable, well-structured signal looks like when the audience for the research is a model rather than a design team.

experience.title: Founder & Research / Growth Operations Lead
bullets: Diagnose why users fail to convert on client sites, combining behavior analytics, funnel data, and on-site review to isolate the specific friction point rather than guessing at it.
Run hypothesis-driven test cycles: state what the data appears to show, design the test, measure, and revise the recommendation when results contradict the assumption.
Analyze mixed qualitative and quantitative datasets and translate them into structured, prioritized recommendations that non-technical stakeholders can act on immediately.
Design evaluation frameworks and self-improving loops that monitor AI agent output quality and continuously optimize against measured results.
Translate loosely-formed stakeholder intent into precise specifications and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between what people say they want and what actually gets built.
Produce written findings, reports, and educational content that make technical and behavioral insights legible to business audiences.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built performance reporting frameworks tracking conversion, CAC, LTV, and ROI, translating behavioral and campaign data into optimization recommendations delivered directly to clients.
Produced landing pages and conversion-focused assets, iterating layout and messaging against measured user response.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Worked with agency partners to position and deploy customer-feedback and survey tooling for their end clients, building familiarity with voice-of-customer collection at scale.
Analyzed partner utilization and product-adoption metrics to identify where users disengaged, then recommended interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to translate structured user feedback into roadmap input across multidisciplinary teams.

experience.title: Account Manager & Onboarding Team Lead
bullets: Ran moderated, task-based working sessions with every e-commerce client launching a store, observing them use the product in real time, asking follow-up questions, and documenting exactly where the experience broke down.
Helped define the usability study approach used as the e-commerce department was built out, establishing how user friction was surfaced and evaluated for a brand-new vertical.
Built customer personas from that launch work and used them to anticipate user needs and shape onboarding flows and site-structure recommendations.
Used heatmaps and on-site behavior analytics (Hotjar) to inform layout and page-structure decisions across client sites.

Synthesized session findings into growth consultations covering site architecture, information structure, and SEO, contributing to a 30% increase in traffic and 25% improvement in conversion across the e-commerce segment.
Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, standardizing how research findings were captured and applied across the portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran in-person and remote discovery sessions with agencies and professional-services firms, mapping how teams actually worked before recommending system and workflow design.
Built and applied buyer personas to anticipate user needs, objections, and motivations ahead of engagement.
Guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, troubleshooting where product design and real user behavior diverged.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for an SMB loyalty and marketing-automation platform, working in person with small business owners to understand how they and their customers used the product.
